business_summary: EPI (Holdings) Limited, an investment holding company, primarily engages in the exploration and production of oil and gas in Canada and Hong Kong. It is also involved in money lending, and invests in security and management activities, as well as generates and sells electricity through solar energy. The company was formerly known as Great Wall Cybertech Limited and changed its name to EPI (Holdings) Limited in September 2006. EPI (Holdings) Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 EPI (Holdings) Limited는 주로 캐나다와 홍콩에서 석유 및 가스 탐사 및 생산에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 자금대출, 보안 및 관리 활동에 투자하고 태양에너지를 통해 전력을 생산 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Great Wall Cybertech Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2006년 9월에 EPI(Holdings) Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. EPI(Holdings) Limited는 1989년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
